description: This is a test source file using pytest for testing exception mapping for Azure-specific errors in the litellm project. It defines a test class with multiple test methods to verify how exceptions with different inner error payloads are handled and mapped to ContentPolicyViolationError, especially focusing on the provider-specific innererror details.

classes.name: TestAzureExceptionMapping
classes.description: Test class for verifying Azure exception mappings, especially innererror details in ContentPolicyViolationError

methods.name: test_azure_content_policy_violation_innererror_access(self)
methods.description: Tests that exceptions with innererror containing content filter results are correctly mapped, and the provider_specific_fields include innererror data with proper content_filter_result details.

methods.name: test_azure_content_policy_violation_different_categories(self)
methods.description: Tests handling of different content filter categories like hate, jailbreak, self_harm, sexual, and violence with various filtered and severity states.

methods.name: test_azure_content_policy_violation_missing_innererror(self)
methods.description: Tests behavior when the exception's body does not include innererror; expects provider_specific_fields to be present but innererror to be None.

methods.name: test_azure_content_policy_violation_non_dict_body(self)
methods.description: Tests handling of a body that is not a dictionary, ensuring innererror remains None and exceptions are properly raised.
